value.rationale: Classifies all equality cases of a 2026 sharp bound over arbitrary ordered coprime triples, including the unit-generator edge case. Shows that the ostensibly three-generator extremal bound is never attained by genuinely three-generated numerical semigroups, a structural distinction relevant to sharpness and future stability work.
